debt_payments_reversal_link_check.name: debt_payments_reversal_link_check
debt_payments_reversal_link_check.value: ("debt_payments"."payment_type" = 'reversal' AND "debt_payments"."reversal_of_payment_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("debt_payments"."payment_type" <> 'reversal' AND "debt_payments"."reversal_of_payment_id" IS NULL)

account_transactions_reversal_link_check.name: account_transactions_reversal_link_check
account_transactions_reversal_link_check.value: ("account_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'reversal' AND "account_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("account_transactions"."transaction_type" <> 'reversal' AND "account_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NULL)

account_transactions_transfer_link_check.name: account_transactions_transfer_link_check
account_transactions_transfer_link_check.value: ("account_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out')) OR "account_transactions"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL
